ObjectiveAudit.Nature: Yaw-rate target preference. Yaw is not beta: r, velocity direction rate and body-velocity angle differ
ObjectiveAudit.NativeTimeEvidenceBefore142: 137 terminal/mean yaw ablation: mean not reliably better; does not establish necessity of yaw penalty.

ObjectiveAudit.Nature: Preference for partial gas; full gas cost1.3073567, no physical justification
ObjectiveAudit.NativeTimeEvidenceBefore142: No isolated native-time evidence of benefit before142.

ObjectiveAudit.NativeTimeEvidenceBefore142: 0/28 offline changes is local redundancy, not proof of global redundancy.

ObjectiveAudit.Nature: Simplified curvature envelope with 20% reserve; 0.8 is heuristic, not a tyre constitutive law or a native speed limit
ObjectiveAudit.NativeTimeEvidenceBefore142: 0/28 isolated changes; cannot infer necessity from historical completion or combined ablation.

ObjectiveAudit.NativeTimeEvidenceBefore142: No isolated time evidence; hard native footprint sweep remains.

SafetyAudit.PhysicalAndGeometric: Point-footprint crossing, invalid/nonfinite state, reverse and original actuator limits; native swept footprint/collision/energy guards retained. Predicted validity is not native certification.
SafetyAudit.CautionMargins: minimumH09 clearance<0.2m or closing-extrapolated futureGap<0.1m => Uncertain, lexicographically loses to every Safe candidate regardless of progress. Not actual DNF.
SafetyAudit.ExperimentalEnvelope: abs(beta)>45deg is retained in main A/B/C for comparability; uncalibrated experimental control envelope, not a proven physical motorcycle limit.
SafetyAudit.Recovery: Original NoSafeContinuation only says no Safe candidate in finite heldH09 set; cannot prove global impossibility.141 H1.8 recovery/preparation gate is a heuristic, not included in142 main policies.
SafetyAudit.NativeNoCandidateC: Abstains and halts within one accepted step with a queued active-action placeholder that never activates before stop; classified controller forecast-infeasible, separately from native DNF.

Modes.A: Original134A #16015 literal score and safety ranking
Modes.B: Max H09 progress, original safety class priority; no score penalties
Modes.C: Max H09 progress over pointwise nominal valid, forward, within footprint boundaries and beta45. No Uncertain priority. No admissible candidate -> controller forecast-infeasibility stop, not physical DNF.

Protocol.Predictor: Original FreeRacingModel H09, one held forecast for each original legal action; no extra recovery forecasts or141 gate. First request only, actual .24s reaction, .2s reviews, original +/-35deg and90deg/s.
Protocol.Safety: Predicted crossing/invalid state vs caution margins(.2m minimum,.1m closing estimate) vs provisional beta45 distinguished. Native footprint sweep, collision, reverse, energy and actuator detectors preserved. Nominal C admissibility is not a safety certificate or proof of recoverability.
Protocol.Scope: Studied bend, next62m, entire next bend and another62m in one continuous WorldRunner; D1/H1 include third bend. No state injection, resets or authored line.
Protocol.Allocation: 3 small A/B/C preflights;12 full D0,D1,H0,H1 A/B/C worlds (terminal preflight reused if same trajectory already ended);2 changed single-penalty branch worlds with full original A main counterpart reused; up to4 diagnostic late objective switches if needed to locate loss of recovery. <=21 planned worlds, never >24.
Protocol.Branches: Original A until selected cached observation; issue one isolated no-component request at that observation; subsequent fresh A decisions. Compare exact predecision state/pending and whole accepted prefix. Original main A is the exact unmodified branch counterpart, not another world.
Protocol.Confirmation: D0/D1 diagnostics; commit confirmation lock before new H0/H1. No policy tuning; historical families already known, not an unseen dataset.
Protocol.Cpu: No per-decision stopping threshold and no warm/cold feasibility claim. Only total24world/450CPU-s guard; near-budget worlds halt and report incomplete scope.
Protocol.DecisionCriteria: Report all legal completion/time pairs, same-point exit/+20/+40/+62 speeds, drive, beta, clearance and DNF. Faster offline or faster-before-DNF is not success; four physically distinct initial families, aliases/prefixes not independent. No target speed or weight fitting.

Cost.Includes: Every native episode including prefixes, every H09 forecast, summary and historical reads. Offline reads conservatively counted. Builds/regression tests excluded; new unit tests use no forecasts/worlds.

Preflight.Meaning: Original3s entire sample SHA matches141; B/C small probes; no decision-CPU gate and behavior DNF retained as evidence.
